Retail Product.meaning: Sold directly at a Department Store

Semi-Product.meaning: Used to build other products; not normally sold at a Department Store

Livestock.meaning: Live animal that populates a Livestock unit on a farm

Livestock Product.meaning: Directly sellable good that comes from an animal (Livestock + Retail Product)

Livestock Semi-Product.meaning: Comes from an animal but used to build other goods (Livestock + Semi-Product)

Plant Product + Retail.meaning: Farm crop that is also directly sellable (Plant Product + Retail Product)
